signal: A 100-item GitHub PR API page with absent Link metadata was treated as final page without checking page N+1.
root_cause: fetch_open_prs returned when _next_link_url was None regardless of a full per_page=100 response.
upstream: GitHub API Link metadata absent or stripped on an exactly-full page
downstream: Authenticated PR inventory can silently omit additional open PRs, undermining dependency ordering.
repair: Probe the next canonical API page whenever a full 100-item page lacks a next Link; fail closed on page bound and >100 records.
rollback: Governed revert of this isolated change only; preserve previous redirect and pagination protections.
recurrence_check: Reopen if any full page without Link yields silent truncation, if bound overflow is accepted, or if direct-head regression fails.
